final_decision.rationale: No new candidate exceeded R0 29.48 dB by the required +2 dB (nor reached >40 dB). Signal re-interpretation confirms the R0 structure (saturation sev5 certified by chroma ratio 0.0; blur real and magnitude-correct at lens:4 by two matched blob signals; JPEG certified by block_boundary=3.983). The only structural alternatives left were disproved: priority-2 order flip 28.52 dB, no-blur 24.27 dB, and a physically corrected 4-step blurred-noise hypothesis rejected in signal mode (WEAK, variance_ratio 238%). Remaining residual is concentrated in block_boundary (33%) and global variance_ratio (25%) but is irreducible within the discrete severity space without lowering PSNR. With k=1 the support is a single pair, so stochastic blur candidates cannot be arbitrated. Pipeline kept unchanged for R1 training / training-PSNR arbitration.
